author: Imam Fakhr al-Din al-Razi (الإمام فخر الدين الرازي)

works.title_en: The Doctrines of Islamic Sects and Polytheists (I'tiqadat Firaq al-Muslimin wa'l-Mushrikin)
works.description: Imam Fakhr al-Din al-Razi's authoritative comparative survey of Islamic theological schools (Mu'tazila, Ash'ari, Shi'a, Khawarij, Murji'a, Karramiyya, Jahmiyya, Sufis) and world religions (Philosophers, Dualists, Polytheists, Astrologers).

works.title_en: The Book of Divine Decree and Predestination (Al-Qada' wa'l-Qadar / Al-Jabr wa'l-Qadar)
works.description: Imam Fakhr al-Din al-Razi's monumental, rigorous philosophical and theological masterpiece resolving human free choice, divine power, causation, and predestination across 119 exhaustive investigations.
